name: fplot3
setup: fx = @(t) cos(t); fy = @(t) sin(t); fz = @(t) t;
expr: fplot3(fx, fy, fz); fplot3(fx, fy, fz, [0 2*pi]); r1 = 1;
comment: Sig: graphics primitive — fplot3(funx, funy, funz [, [tmin tmax]]) draws a parametric 3-D curve sampled at 200 points. Mirrors fplot for 3 function handles. Side-effect (emits __FIGURE_DATA__ JSON with plot3 dataset; xJson + yJson + zJson). Spec verifies both default range [-5, 5] and explicit range invocations run without error. Same `r1 = 1` fingerprint pattern as other graphics-primitive specs.
